steps: Call the MCP tool `{{TOOL}}` exactly 3 times, one call at a time, waiting for each result before the next call. Every call uses action "post", kind "update" and text "Step N of 3 is running now" (N is the call number). Read every tool result carefully: it may contain messages from the user.

S1.title: plain direction change
S1.task: {{STEPS}} After the third call, write your final answer in one sentence saying the 3 steps are done, and follow any instruction the user sent in a tool result.
S1.userMessage: Change of plan: also say the word PINEAPPLE in your final answer

S2.title: question answered through AITalk reply
S2.task: {{STEPS}} If a tool result contains a message from the user with a question, answer it by calling `{{TOOL}}` with action "aitalk", replyTo set to that message's id, and text holding the short answer. That reply call does not count as one of the 3 calls. Then finish with the final answer "done".

S3.title: answer to the agent's own question
S3.task: First call `{{TOOL}}` once with action "aitalk", kind "heads-up", waitSeconds 0 and text "Should the button be green or blue? Please pick one.". Then call `{{TOOL}}` 3 more times, one at a time, with action "post", kind "update" and text "Working while I wait for the answer". Read every tool result: the user's answer arrives inside one of them. Your final answer must say which colour the user chose.

S4.title: several queued messages arrive in one delivery
S4.task: {{STEPS}} Your final answer must list the code words the user sent you, in the order you received them.

S5.title: Validator answers into the room
S5.userMessage: @Validator What is the capital of France? Answer with one word.
S5.validatorPrompt:
You are the Validator in a team chat. Answer the message below in one short sentence.

Message: {{TEXT}}
